name: LYNX® Sedona 30" Free Standing Grill Cover
shortDescription: Made to protect your grill from outdoor elements, this cover helps shield against dust, moisture, and debris when the unit is not in use. Its durable construction is designed for a secure fit while helping extend the life and appearance of your outdoor cooking equipment.
metaDescription: Lynx Sedona Professional Series 30" Free Standing Grill Cover with textured vinyl and tailored fit

features.text: Tailored for a perfect fit with a secure, concealed zipper
Delicate touch—felt lining protects stainless steel finishes
Quick placement—nylon finger loops help pull and secure the cover in place
Secure durability—pocket seams for lasting quality and a flexible cord for a close fit
